response.answer:
The features were used in a machine learning model (for troll detection).

The paper states that the authors "study the effect of a set of text-based features" and "propose a machine learning model to detect them" [6]. Specifically, they "built a new machine learning model based on theme-based and profiling features" which, in cross-validation evaluation, achieved an F1macro value of 0.94 [3].
